---
title: "Trump Trade War 2.0"
description: "Steel and aluminium tariffs trigger a two-phase EU retaliation package, then a threatened 200% tariff on French wine catches even Trump's own Treasury Secretary off-guard."
date: "2025-03-13"
categories: [trade-wars]
---

On March 12, 2025, the administration's 25% tariffs on steel and aluminium
imports drew a retaliatory EU package targeting up to €26.5 billion of US
exports in two phases, including bourbon, motorcycles, and agricultural
goods. The next day Trump escalated further, threatening a 200% tariff on
French wine and EU alcohol more broadly — reportedly catching Treasury
Secretary Scott Bessent off-guard. Canada matched with its own 25%
counter-tariffs on goods like computers and sporting equipment. EU leaders
signalled openness to negotiation while warning plainly that "tariffs are
taxes" that damage businesses and consumers on both sides.

**Originally published on Substack**, March 13, 2025.
